account: Mattias Nilsson Benfatto, Gustaf Öqvist Seimyr, Jan Ygge, Tony Pansell and Agneta Rydberg of Karolinska Institutet worked with Christer Jacobson of Linnaeus University. Their PLoS ONE study (9 December 2016) showed eye-movement recordings of under one minute of reading can identify 9–10-year-olds at risk of persistent reading difficulties. With cross-validation on 97 high-risk and 88 low-risk control subjects, a support-vector machine with recursive feature elimination selected 48 of 168 features. It reached 95.6% (± 4.5%) accuracy with balanced sensitivity and specificity. The competing-interests statement says that Benfatto and Seimyr own equity in Optolexia, a company aiming to offer technologies for assessing reading deficits in school-age children. The venture is funded by Sweden's innovation agency VINNOVA. The work was also supported by the Ulla and Ingemar Dahlberg Foundation and the Promobilia Foundation, and data are on Figshare. This study was examined as the research basis of the Lexplore school screener. That name does not appear in the source text and no deployment source was found.

fields.account: Mattias Nilsson Benfatto, Gustaf Öqvist Seimyr, Jan Ygge, Tony Pansell and Agneta Rydberg of Karolinska Institutet worked with Christer Jacobson of Linnaeus University. Their PLoS ONE study (9 December 2016) showed eye-movement recordings of under one minute of reading can identify 9–10-year-olds at risk of persistent reading difficulties. With cross-validation on 97 high-risk and 88 low-risk control subjects, a support-vector machine with recursive feature elimination selected 48 of 168 features. It reached 95.6% (± 4.5%) accuracy with balanced sensitivity and specificity. The competing-interests statement says that Benfatto and Seimyr own equity in Optolexia, a company aiming to offer technologies for assessing reading deficits in school-age children. The venture is funded by Sweden's innovation agency VINNOVA. The work was also supported by the Ulla and Ingemar Dahlberg Foundation and the Promobilia Foundation, and data are on Figshare. This study was examined as the research basis of the Lexplore school screener. That name does not appear in the source text and no deployment source was found.
